# A Word in Season

> Hand-picked Bible verses for church occasions — birthdays, weddings, baptisms, funerals, housewarmings and more — each with an opening prayer, three talking points and a closing blessing. Verses are shown in English (King James Version), Hindi and Telugu (Indian Revised Version, 2019). Built for Bro. Raj Timothy, Smyrna House of Fellowship.

Verse text is quoted exactly from the source translations. The KJV is public domain; the Hindi and Telugu IRV are © Bridge Connectivity Solutions under CC BY-SA 4.0 (via eBible.org) and must be attributed when reused.

## Occasions

- [Birthday](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/birthday): 27 verses for birthdays, e.g. Psalm 118:24, Psalm 139:13-14, Jeremiah 29:11
- [Wedding](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/wedding): 28 verses for weddings, e.g. Genesis 2:24, 1 Corinthians 13:4-7, Ecclesiastes 4:9-12
- [Engagement](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/engagement): 23 verses for engagements, e.g. Proverbs 19:14, Amos 3:3, Song of Solomon 8:6
- [Wedding Anniversary](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/wedding-anniversary): 23 verses for wedding anniversaries, e.g. 1 Samuel 7:12, Lamentations 3:22-23, Psalm 126:3
- [Baptism](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/baptism): 26 verses for baptism services, e.g. Matthew 28:19-20, Romans 6:4, Acts 2:38
- [Baby Dedication](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/baby-dedication): 25 verses for baby dedications, e.g. 1 Samuel 1:27-28, Psalm 127:3, Psalm 139:13-14
- [Funeral & Comfort](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/funeral-and-comfort): 29 verses for funerals and times of grief, e.g. John 11:25-26, John 14:1-3, Psalm 23:1-4
- [Housewarming](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/housewarming): 22 verses for housewarmings and new homes, e.g. Joshua 24:15, Psalm 127:1, Proverbs 24:3-4
- [Exams & Graduation](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/exams-and-graduation): 26 verses for exams and graduations, e.g. Proverbs 1:7, James 1:5, Philippians 4:13
- [New Job & Business](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/new-job-and-business): 24 verses for a new job or business, e.g. Proverbs 16:3, Deuteronomy 8:18, Colossians 3:23-24
- [Farewell & Travel](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/farewell-and-travel): 27 verses for farewells and journeys, e.g. Numbers 6:24-26, Psalm 121:7-8, Genesis 28:15
- [Healing & Sickness](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/healing-and-sickness): 26 verses for healing and times of sickness, e.g. James 5:14-15, Jeremiah 17:14, Isaiah 53:5
- [Ordination & Ministry](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/ordination-and-ministry): 28 verses for ordinations and ministry commissioning, e.g. Isaiah 6:8, Jeremiah 1:7-8, 2 Timothy 4:2
- [Thanksgiving & Harvest](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/thanksgiving-and-harvest): 26 verses for thanksgiving and harvest festivals, e.g. Psalm 100:4-5, 1 Thessalonians 5:16-18, Psalm 107:1
- [Christmas](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/christmas): 27 verses for Christmas, e.g. Isaiah 9:6, Luke 2:10-11, Matthew 1:23
- [Good Friday & Easter](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/good-friday-and-easter): 29 verses for Good Friday and Easter, e.g. Isaiah 53:5, Romans 5:8, John 19:30
- [New Year](https://a-word-in-season.rently-campus.workers.dev/occasions/new-year): 29 verses for the New Year, e.g. Lamentations 3:22-23, Isaiah 43:18-19, Philippians 3:13-14
